messages:
Jo: Quick one 3 launch checklist for SEO + redirects before webinar. Need a tiny playbook for content ops so we don't accidentally lose rankings.

Maggie: High level: map legacy URLs -> canonical, set server-side 301s for permanent, 302/307 for short promos. Update internal links in CMS.

Elsa: I'll run a prioritized organic pages export (top 200 pages) and mark any URLs used in email templates.

Raj: Infra advice: avoid chaining redirects. If migrating /resources/old -> /resources/hub, make direct 301 to final. nginx snippet: 
```
rewrite ^/resources/old/(.*)$ /resources/hub/$1 permanent;
```

Sam: Tracking: add ?src=email or ?src=paid on campaign entry only. Don't bake UTM into canonicals. GA4 needs consistent event names: webinar_reg, benchmark_read.

Jo: Also want schema checks: Event for webinar, Article+FAQ for benchmark posts. Who can own markup?

Elsa: MarketingOps will add schema and update sitemap <lastmod>. I'll also produce a CSV: url,organic_sessions,proposed_action,new_url,owner.

Raj: I'll open redirect PR to infra/redirects and include a small smoke test: 
```
curl -I https://redwood.ai/old-resource
# expect 301 to /resources/hub
```

SEO Bot: Reminder: run Lighthouse and a crawl after deploy. Report broken links and canonical mismatches.

Maggie: Action owners: Elsa (crawl + CSV), Raj (redirect PR + tests), Sam (GA spec). We'll freeze redirect merges 24h before launch. Ping PR links here.

Jo: Great. ETA: CSV Mon noon, PR Tue EOD. Thanks!
